assignmentTitle: Design of a Power Screw for a Hydraulic Press

criteria.title: Understanding Hydraulic Press Application & Scope
criteria.description: Student reviews the Hydraulic Press Project Charter and accepts the design brief for the hydraulic press bed-adjustment power screw mechanism.

criteria.title: Hydraulic Press & Power Screw Component Identification
criteria.description: Accurate identification of Hydraulic Cylinder, Pressure Gauge, Hydraulic Piston / Ram, Pressing Head, Adjustable Press Bed, Guide Columns, Hydraulic Pump Unit, Bed-Adjustment Power Screw, Operating Handwheel, and Thread & Collar Friction Interfaces on the Hydraulic Press diagram.

criteria.title: Load Path & Motion Mechanism Differentiation
criteria.description: Clear mechanical distinction between the primary hydraulic pressing actuator load path (Fluid Power -> Ram -> Workpiece) and the manual bed-adjustment power screw mechanism (Handwheel -> Screw -> Bed Elevation).

criteria.title: Engineering Design Data & Operating Parameters
criteria.description: Correct identification of the axial bed lifting load (W = 25 kN), Tr 40x6 trapezoidal thread, coefficient of friction values, collar dimensions, and handwheel radius.

criteria.title: Screw Geometry & Helix Angle Calculation
criteria.description: Accurate calculation of core diameter (dc = 34 mm), mean diameter (dm = 37 mm), lead (l = 6 mm), and thread helix angle (alpha = 2.955 deg).

criteria.title: Virtual Friction Angle & Thread Friction Torque
criteria.description: Application of trapezoidal thread virtual friction (mu' = 0.1553, phi' = 8.827 deg) and calculation of thread friction torque (Tt = 96.47 N-m).

criteria.title: Thrust Collar Radius & Collar Friction Torque
criteria.description: Calculation of mean thrust collar radius (Rc = 30 mm) and resulting collar friction torque (Tc = 90.00 N-m).

criteria.title: Total Operating Torque, Handwheel Effort & Mechanical Efficiency
criteria.description: Determination of total lifting torque (Ttotal = 186.47 N-m), operator tangential hand force (Fh = 932.35 N or 466.2 N rim couple), and mechanism efficiency (eta = 12.80%).

criteria.title: Self-Locking Verification & Fail-Safe Operation
criteria.description: Analysis of self-locking criteria (phi' > alpha), positive lowering torque (Tlower = 137.57 N-m), and gravity drop prevention.

criteria.title: Stress Analysis & Factor of Safety Recommendation
criteria.description: Evaluation of direct compressive stress (sigma_c = 27.53 MPa), torsional shear stress (tau = 12.50 MPa), maximum principal stress (sigma_max = 32.36 MPa), and justification of robust Factor of Safety (FOS = 11.74).

criteria.title: Comprehensive Technical Design Report
criteria.description: Concise, structured engineering synthesis report integrating all quantitative findings, safety verification, and operational recommendations for Hydraulic Press power screw design.
